terms.context: Windows notification area where app icons appear
terms.notes: Use 'system tray' consistently, not 'notification area' or 'taskbar'

terms.context: A single piece of content the user creates
terms.notes: Lowercase unless starting a sentence. Never 'memo', 'entry', or 'item'

terms.context: A category nested inside another category (Tree mode)
terms.notes: One word, no hyphen. Never 'sub-category' or 'child category'

terms.context: Where deleted notes go before permanent deletion
terms.notes: Never 'recycle bin', 'bin', or 'deleted items' as a noun. 'Deleted items' is acceptable as a description ('view deleted items') but 'trash' is the container name

terms.context: Right-side panel showing read-only note content
terms.notes: Always 'preview panel', never 'preview pane' or 'reading panel'

terms.context: Center panel showing notes in the selected category
terms.notes: Always 'note list', never 'note table' or 'note grid'
Always 'category panel', never 'category tree' (tree is a mode, not the panel name)

terms.context: Lightweight note capture via global hotkey
terms.notes: Lowercase unless starting a sentence. Two words, never 'quicknote'

terms.context: The dialog where you create or edit a note
terms.notes: Always 'note editor', never 'note dialog', 'edit window', or 'editor dialog'

terms.context: Unsaved note content preserved between sessions
Setting that saves notes automatically after a delay
Running from a USB drive with data stored next to the executable
terms.notes: Always 'portable mode', never 'portable version' or 'USB mode'

terms.context: Visual mark in the editor title bar showing the note has unsaved changes
terms.notes: Never 'dirty indicator', 'dirty flag', or 'modified marker'. The marker character itself must be verified from source code

terms.context: An audio recording stored as a note
terms.notes: Two words. Never 'audio note', 'recording', or 'voice memo'

terms.context: System-wide keyboard shortcut that works from any application
terms.notes: Always 'global hotkey', never 'system shortcut' or 'global shortcut'
The sort mode where users arrange notes by hand. Never 'custom order' or 'manual order'
Capitalize 'Tree' when referring to the mode name. In running text: 'Tree mode', not 'tree mode' or 'Tree Mode'

terms.context: Category mode with a simple non-hierarchical list
terms.notes: Capitalize 'Flat' when referring to the mode name
